newsitem.title: GERMANY: TENNIS-SLOVAK KUCERA DUMPS BRUGERA OUT OF STUTTGART.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-SLOVAK KUCERA DUMPS BRUGERA OUT OF STUTTGART.

text.p: Unseeded Karol Kucera of Slovakia defeated fourth seed Sergi Brugera 6-3 2-6 7-5 to reach the semifinals of the Stuttgart clay-court tournament on Saturday and prevent a Spanish sweep of places in the last four.
Play in their quarter-final was delayed for several hours because of heavy rain, which had already caused the match to be held over from Friday.
Kucera will take on Spaniard Albert Portas in the semifinals. Portas beat 10th-seeded compatriot Felix Mantilla 6-2 6-4.
The inclement weather also forced organisers to postpone the semifinals from Saturday to Sunday morning, with the final to be played in the afternoon.
Albert Costa meets third-seeded fellow Spaniard Alex Corretja in the other semifinal.
